teaser: You tap the elevator button twice, impatient, before the doors even open. Life path 1 asks for someone who leads by instinct and stands on their own account; INTP arrives already living half in a private architecture of ideas, testing each one against itself before it meets daylight. Put the two together and you get a person who would rather build the whole model alone and show it finished than explain the thinking as it happens. The pull to go first and the pull to retreat into the problem can look like the same thing from outside, and they are not.
